notes.subject: במפגיע
notes.rationale: KJV yoona 'igũrũ rĩa mahũa makĩrĩa gatagatĩ' (mũthenya ũkaheanie); ASV/JPS yona 'nĩguo ũnye kĩndũ kĩrĩa gĩkĩhĩtũkĩtie' (mũgwanja wa kũhĩtũkĩra)

notes.subject: makũmbĩ merĩ-inĩ
notes.rationale: Geneva/KJV yona 'mahũa' handũ ha makũmbĩ; Kihibirania kiuugĩte makũmbĩ, nĩ makwĩguo

notes.subject: nĩguo ũkĩhĩtũkĩre kĩndũ gĩa kũgwa
notes.rationale: Kiugo kĩa thutha kĩa במפגיע kĩrĩa gĩaheanie Kĩgĩkũyũ kĩingĩ kũingĩra harĩa gĩa kĩhĩtũkĩra kĩetagwo

translation: Jũ makũmbĩ merĩ-inĩ nĩatekire ⟨ũtheri⟩, na akĩahũrĩra ndagĩka yake, nĩguo ũkĩhĩtũkĩre kĩndũ gĩa kũgwa.
